consumers.Technical Artist: render + encode every `process[].render_cmd`, then `encode` steps; write outputs under assets/audio/
consumers.Game Developer: src/core/audio.js loads `cues` (file_ogg/file_aac relative to assets/audio/), implements `mixer`, `event_routing`, `music_state_machine`

mixer.volume_curve: gain_dB(v) = 40*log10(v / v_default), clamp <= +4 dB; v = 0 is hard mute. Defaults master 80, music 70, sfx 90, ui 80 = 0 dB.
fire_order: step coalescing: one voice per cue per 16.67 ms sim step; +1.5 dB per doubling of count, cap +3 dB
sub-bus cap then global cap: steal lowest priority (ties oldest) only if new priority >= victim; never_victim voices are never stolen
every stolen voice: 15 ms linear ramp to 0, then stop()
mixer.positional: pan = clamp((x - camera.midX) / 320, -1, 1) * spatial.width (0.5 world/enemy, 0.25 player-originated)

D7_low_hp.combine: with D6 use the lower cutoff

ducks.combine_rule: several ducks on one bus: apply the deepest, never the sum; setTargetAtTime ramps; hold measured from trigger
ducks.fallback: if the BiquadFilter on music is not clean in Phaser routing, drop the filter part of D6/D7 and keep the gain moves

event_routing.cast: cast_<element of the first spell fired this cast step>; + cast_multicast_layer if shots >= 3; + cast_heavy_layer if heavy (group has `heavy` modifier or spell in {comet, fireball, frost_lance, thunder_orb}). One routing per cast step, never per projectile.
event_routing.hit_enemy: hit_<element>; elementless damage (reaction, relic explode) routes nothing (its own cue covers it)

kill.fire_imp: self-destruct or killed mid-fuse -> explode_small (no kill cue)

event_routing.explode: radiusPx >= bigExplosionRadiusPx (40) ? explode_big : explode_small; relic explode uses the same rule; boss unravel bursts -> explode_small with gain offset -9 dB
event_routing.chain_zap: chain_zap (chain modifier arcs and thunder_orb zap ticks)
event_routing.door_close: door_close (+ music COMBAT transition after rules.waves.roomEnterGraceMs)
event_routing.enemy_windup: windup_<type> for melee_swipe->swipe, shoot, ring, spiral, charge, slam, summon, blink, self_destruct; hazard -> windup_hazard_acid (acid_pools) | windup_hazard_fire (fire_zones)
event_routing.enemy_release: melee_swipe->release_swipe, shoot->release_shoot, ring->release_ring (per volley), spiral->release_ring (once, at start), charge->enemy_charge_go, slam(target)->enemy_leap, slam(self)->heavy_impact, summon->enemy_summon_rise, blink->enemy_blink_out then enemy_blink_in at W+1, self_destruct->explode_small, hazard->hazard_on_acid|hazard_on_fire
event_routing.boss_death: boss_death (+ stg_boss_clear or stg_victory at +600 ms)
event_routing.overlay_open: ui_book_open (reward modal: reward_open instead) + D6 state

EXPLORE.enter_from_title: title out 1000 ms, explore in 2000 ms
EXPLORE.on: run_start, room_enter{kind in start, landing, treasure, shop}, after room_clear

COMBAT.crossfade: EQUAL-POWER 1200 ms explore->combat: g_out = cos(t*pi/2), g_in = sin(t*pi/2). Explore PAUSES (keeps position) when its fade ends; the combat bed RESUMES from its last position (first combat of a floor starts at 0).
COMBAT.note: door_close slam + wave_spawn mask the crossfade

RELEASE.timeline: t=0 stg_room_clear (D3); combat bed fades out 600 ms then pauses (keeps position); t=400 ms explore resumes with a 2500 ms fade-in (equal-power curve)

BOSS.enter: boss room: explore fades out over bossIntroPanMs 900 ms; at boss_activate roar + stg_boss_intro, then *_p1 starts at sample 0 when the stinger ends
BOSS.phase: boss_phase: current bed fades 300 ms from t=0; stg_boss_phase + roar; next bed starts at sample 0 at t=900 ms with 100 ms fade-in
BOSS.down: boss_death: bed fades 400 ms; stg_boss_clear (F1-F2) or stg_victory (F3) at +600 ms; F1-F2: EXPLORE resumes 2000 ms after stinger start (3000 ms fade); F3: run-end then TITLE after the stinger

DEATH.timeline: D8 (beds out 700 ms, ambience out 1200 ms); stg_death at +400 ms; TITLE after the stinger

FLOOR.rule: explore keeps playing; floor 2 amb_cave detune -200 cents; floor 3 swaps combat bed to mus_combat_b

music_state_machine.cycle_safety: a transition arriving mid-crossfade retargets ramps from current values; room_clear never fires in BOSS; stingers newest_replaces_oldest

load_groups.boot: all sfx, ui, stingers (~14 MB decoded)
load_groups.title: mus_title — unload when a run starts
load_groups.run: mus_explore, mus_combat_a, amb_cave — load at run start
load_groups.floor3: mus_combat_b — load on floor 3 entry, unload mus_combat_a
load_groups.boss_a: mus_boss_a_p1/p2 — load on floor 1-2 boss-room entry (during the 900 ms pan), unload after boss_death
load_groups.boss_final: mus_boss_final_p1..p3 — load on floor 3 boss-room entry, unload mus_combat_b first

encode.step_1_render: mkdir -p assets/_work/audio; run each cue's process[].render_cmd from the project root -> assets/_work/audio/<name>.pre.wav (32-bit float, so summed layers and hot music never clip before step 3)
encode.step_2_measure: one-shots (SFX/UI/stinger): ffmpeg -i <name>.pre.wav -af apad=pad_dur=0.5,ebur128=peak=true -f null -  -> M_pre = the highest M: value, TP_pre = the final Peak: value. Loops: read I and Peak.
encode.step_3_normalize_one_shot: G = min(-14 - M_pre, 5 - TP_pre)  (at most ~6 dB of limiting; a peaky source then lands under -14 rather than being crushed). ffmpeg -i <name>.pre.wav -af "aresample=176400,volume=<G>dB,adelay=10:all=1,alimiter=limit=0.85:attack=5:release=50:level=disabled,atrim=start=0.010,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aresample=44100" -c:a pcm_s16le assets/_work/audio/<name>.wav  (4x oversampled limiter -> true peak <= -1.0 dBTP; verified on pickup_coin, whose 8-13 kHz sparkle overshoots a 1x limiter).
encode.step_3_normalize_loop: G = reference_level.target - I; ffmpeg -i <name>.pre.wav -af volume=<G>dB -c:a pcm_s16le assets/_work/audio/<name>.wav ; confirm Peak <= -1.5 dBTP (scratch render 2026-09-27: every bed lands -3.5 .. -8.7 dBTP; amb_cave -1.7 at its -18.5 target). No limiter on loops: it would break the seam.
encode.step_4_variant_match: re-measure max M of every variant of a cue; attenuate every variant louder than the quietest by (its M - quietest M) so all variants sit within 1 dB. cue_file_M = the quietest variant's M.
encode.step_5_ogg: oggenc -q 4 -o assets/audio/<name>.ogg assets/_work/audio/<name>.wav (SFX, UI, ambience); oggenc -q 5 for stingers and music
encode.step_6_m4a: ffmpeg -i assets/_work/audio/<name>.wav -c:a aac_at -b:a 96k assets/audio/<name>.m4a (stingers + music 160k; fallback encoder -c:a aac)
encode.step_7_gain_correct: one-shots only: write default_gain_db = min(0, mix_target_lufs - cue_file_M) into the runtime copy (the design value assumes cue_file_M = -14; short or peaky files land 1-7 dB under, e.g. 73 ms hit_arcane measures ~-19, so its runtime gain rises by ~5 dB to keep the level plan). Loops keep default_gain_db as specified.
encode.step_8_record: fill `measured` per file: M or I, true peak dBTP, final duration ms, and small_speaker_loss_db for loops + sfx_critical cues (loudness delta through highpass=f=250,highpass=f=250); must be <= 6 dB.
encode.runtime_copy: after step 8: jq -c 'del(.encode, .measured) | .cues |= map(del(.process, .provenance, .linked_artifacts, .abx_transparency))' specs/audio/cue-spec.json > assets/audio/cue-spec.json (the full file is ~390 KB; the compact runtime copy is ~122 KB). core/inputs.js cueSpec = 'assets/audio/cue-spec.json'; files[].file_ogg / file_aac are relative to assets/audio/.

measured.method: ffmpeg ebur128=peak=true on the final 16-bit WAV (one-shots: max momentary M; loops: integrated I), small_speaker_loss_db = loudness delta through highpass=f=250,highpass=f=250
